rules.description: An approved mine closure plan must be in place
rules.remediation: Prepare and obtain regulatory approval for a mine closure plan with post-closure land-use objectives.

rules.description: A closure cost estimate (rehabilitation liability) must be maintained
rules.remediation: Commission a third-party closure liability estimate updated at least every 3 years.

rules.description: Financial provisioning must cover at least 100% of the closure liability
rules.remediation: Increase the rehabilitation bond/trust provisioning to fully cover the current closure cost estimate.

rules.description: Progressive rehabilitation must keep pace: at least 30% of available disturbance rehabilitated
rules.remediation: Accelerate progressive rehabilitation of completed areas (topsoil, re-contour, reseed) in the next campaign.

rules.description: Topsoil stockpiles must be inventoried for closure use
rules.remediation: Survey and record topsoil stockpile volumes and locations for rehabilitation planning.

rules.description: A biodiversity management plan must exist where significant habitat is disturbed
rules.remediation: Develop a biodiversity management plan addressing threatened species and offset requirements.
